description: This file contains extension methods for configuring page routing conventions in ASP.NET Core MVC, specifically for adding folder routes for pages within certain areas, including admin-specific routes.

classes.name: PageConventionCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for PageConventionCollection to add folder routes for pages.

methods.name: AddAreaFolderRoute
methods.description: Adds a folder route for all pages in a specified area and folder, excluding admin pages.

methods.name: AddAdminAreaFolderRoute
methods.description: Adds a folder route for all admin pages in a specified area and folder.

methods.name: AddAreaFolderRouteInternal
methods.description: Internal method that implements the logic for adding folder routes, distinguishing admin pages based on path or properties.
